title: Customer demo and release rhythm, with a change of mind
lines: Morning. Two things today: the customer demo and our release rhythm.
For the demo, I suggest we move it to Thursday, so the new dashboard is ready.
Thursday is bad for the customer, they have a board meeting.
Then let us keep it on Wednesday and show the old dashboard.
Yes. The demo stays on Wednesday.
Maybe we could also record the demo for people who cannot join.
Maybe. It is an idea, but nobody has asked for it.
Yusuf, please prepare the demo account by Tuesday.
About the release rhythm. Some people want weekly releases instead of every two weeks.
I think weekly is too fast for the testers.
I think it is fine if we automate more tests.
We will not settle that today. Should we move to weekly releases? Let us think about it until the next meeting.
Hana, if the testers agree, could you write a short proposal for the next meeting?
Sure, I can write it before the next meeting.
